## Body

Read current RULINGS.md C33/C34 before using older role notes. C33 makes the user account the trust boundary: same-user seat claims, ID preoccupation, local socket races and operator-env attacks are out of scope. The earlier Daemon notice IDs need a protected dedupe namespace note and temporary req-10/C32 acceptance advice are historical, not grounds to reopen same-user blocks. Req-10 is dropped; #183 and #194 closed unmerged. Keep caller derivation/contradiction guards, safe rendering, secrets/supply-chain checks and external-input defenses.

C34 limits review to two rounds. Round 2 checks the fix; new hardening/proof gaps are C34 follow-up, not another blocking cycle. Only real normal-use correctness failures justify withholding final acceptance. Extra mutants, fixtures and exhaustive inventories are optional.

Retained rendering lesson: new-name admission grammar does not sanitize stored history. Check the actual sink. #177's legacy CLI line remained raw despite #182; whole-word shell quoting prevents shell breakout, not terminal or model instruction confusion. #184 bde88d0 source-closed S184-001 by rendering project/role/instance through a closed grammar and length-only invalid text, including historical holdings. That closure is not blanket sanitization of unrelated prompt fields.

Close only tombstones, never kills the process or reused pane. #200 87f7f8b keeps owner-close at the store write, including concurrent registration; explicit revive/reclaim remain deliberate overrides. F151 and stated predecessor/legacy-reason limits remain follow-ups.

Herring's last review is #201 PASS at 139c9003b684144541648c28e2e7cd47b95bc6f4: the stale until-#200 parenthetical is removed; close then kill-pane stands. No review remains in flight; squirrel continues security. Reviews used exact-head source and CI proof, no local builds/tests/probes. Native output commits and public comments are authoritative. Never use a follow-up question dialog; publish, explicitly send the verdict, then end the turn. The reviewed code/worktrees were not modified.
